info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Model By Param1-spec
info.description: The Financial Instrument Valuation Model Retrieval API enables users to obtain detailed information about financial instrument valuation models based on a specific parameter. This API caters to financial analysts, risk managers, and application developers who require access to model data for evaluation purposes. By utilizing the path parameter, users can efficiently retrieve precise model details relevant to their analyses and decision-making processes. This API streamlines the process of acquiring model information necessary for effective financial management.

get.summary: Retrieve a financial instrument valuation model by its identifier.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about a specific financial instrument valuation model using its unique identifier. The response includes all relevant attributes and configurations of the model, facilitating assessment and usage in financial analysis.

requestBody.description: A request body containing the necessary parameters to retrieve financial instrument valuation models. This operation specifically targets the valuation model identified by 'RES-100045'.

200.description: The request was successful, and the financial instrument valuation model details are returned.

GetModelByParam1Request.title: Financial Instrument Valuation Model Request Body
GetModelByParam1Request.description: This schema represents a string payload for the financial instrument valuation model request body.

GetModelByParam1Response_200.title: Financial Instrument Valuation Model Response

modelId.description: Unique identifier for the financial model.

asOfDate.description: Date as of which the model is evaluated.

scenario.description: Scenario under which the valuation is performed.

instrumentType.description: Type of financial instrument being valued.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol for the financial instrument.

issueCurrency.description: Currency in which the instrument is issued.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the record was last updated.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: Region where the processing took place.

metadata.description: Metadata information related to the response.

GetModelByParam1Response_200.description: This schema represents the response structure for retrieving financial instrument valuation model details.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: An identifier for the API endpoint, which provides a unique reference for tracking and management purposes.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that is processing the request, useful for logging and monitoring application performance.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication scheme, which allows clients to send a token (JWT) in the Authorization header of their requests. The token must be valid and correctly signed to access protected resources.
